primary.title: Zerodha launches India's first life cycle funds: Know how the 2 new schemes work, minimum investment, and suitability
primary.summary: Zerodha Fund House has launched the life cycle fund series, becoming the first AMC to offer target-date mutual funds in the Indian mutual fund industry. The life cycle fund category was introduced by SEBI in February 2026.
